user.title: ⏰ Step 1/7 — Base
user.description:
Welcome to SmartWAKE!

Give your alarm a name (e.g. "Weekday", "Gym", "Kids"), choose the wake time and active days.

You can create multiple independent alarms — one for each need.

lumiere.title: 💡 Step 2/7 — Light & dawn
lumiere.description:
SmartWAKE simulates a sunrise for a gentle wake-up.

Brightness increases progressively over 5-60 min, up to the maximum. The dawn simulation starts before the wake time.

musique.title: 🎵 Step 3/7 — Music
musique.description:
SmartWAKE starts music at wake time with a progressive volume.

The volume increases gently from 'initial' to 'final' over the configured duration. You can use a Spotify playlist, radio URL or local file.

confort.title: 🏠 Step 4/7 — Comfort
confort.description:
Your home prepares before you wake up.

Heating switches to comfort mode, hot water starts, coffee maker turns on, and blinds open if the sun is up.

data.volets_soleil: Open blinds only if the sun is up

intelligence.title: 🧠 Step 5/7 — Contextual intelligence
intelligence.description:
SmartWAKE adapts to your context.

— Won't ring if you're away
— Ignores public holidays (via workday sensor)
— Detects if you're in bed (Withings)
— Stops if you're already up (kitchen motion)
— Aligns with your calendar (1st event − margin)
— Wakes you in light sleep phase (±N min window)

data.mouvement_stop: Stop alarm on bathroom motion (= up)
data.lever_anticippe: Cancel if early wake-up (kitchen motion before wake time)
data.sommeil_phase: Wake in light sleep phase (±N min window)

notification.title: 📱 Step 6/7 — Notification & controls
notification.description:
Get an actionable notification with Snooze / Stop buttons, and a voice briefing when you get up.

If you don't respond, SmartWAKE escalates: max volume + all lights to 100%.

ai.title: 🤖 Step 7/7 — AI Task (optional)
ai.description:
AI features — requires HA ≥ 2025.8 and an AI Task integration configured (local Ollama, Anthropic, Google or OpenAI).

— Natural morning briefing generated by AI
— Adaptive music based on context
— Wake time suggestion every evening
— Weekly sleep report
— Camera-based get-up verification

AI never triggers the alarm itself. Automatic fallback if unavailable.

data.ai_musique_adapt: Adaptive AI music (choice based on weather)
data.ai_verif_lever: Camera+AI get-up verification (10 min after Stop)
